slides.title: How to know a crewing agent is *scamming* you
slides.sub: Check before you send your passport.

slides.title: They ask you to pay
slides.body: The MLC bans recruitment fees for seafarers. Exceptions: your medical, seafarer's book and passport. Visas? The shipowner pays.

slides.title: The offer came on WhatsApp
slides.body: Unsolicited offers by WhatsApp, social media or personal email top the red flags in DG Shipping's seafarer advisory.

slides.title: The contract is vague
slides.body: No vessel name, employer, wages or repatriation terms? Don't sign. Ask for the full agreement first.

slides.title: No *active* licence
slides.body: India: check the RPSL is active on the DG Shipping site. Philippines: check the licence on dmw.gov.ph.

slides.a: A small fee guarantees you the job.
slides.b: Real placement is free. Cash for a "guaranteed" job is the classic scam.

slides.question: Has an agent ever asked you to pay?
slides.line: Licensed agencies show their RPSL in Ocean Link.
